# GlassesLayout:clearAndDisplayExtended

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Clear layout and display text at position x, y with optional extra commands.

```lua
layout:clearAndDisplayExtended(params)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `params` |  | yes | table with elements: |

Fields of `params`:

- `x` (integer): left
- `y` (integer): top
- `text` (text): text
- `commands`(table): table of extra commands (font, text, bitmap)


## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function wakeup(context)
  context.layout:clearAndDisplayExtended({
     x=10,
     y=10,
     text="ARMED!",
     commands={
         {text={text="Extra1", font=2, x=10, y=10}},
         {text={text="Extra2", font=2, x=50, y=10}},
         {bitmap={id=10, x=10, y=40}}
     }})
end
```
